reviews.experienceReview: Construction, registration and learning award nothing. A completed sheltered rest can plausibly provide relief and a personal sense of refuge, but only after actual beneficial use. Subscribe shelter-rest-experience for the resting actor alone: require a successful rest round beneath a proven, currently sound roof, with measured reduction of uncomfortable heat, wetness or exposure and no worsening of total physical discomfort. One qualifying event grants transient refuge relief of 0.3, capped at 0.6 for 6 rounds; repeat events refresh rather than stack, with a 12-round award cooldown. Separately, two qualifying occupied rest rounds within 20 rounds establish continued personal applicability; subsequent qualifying rest events add 0.015 maintained satisfaction, capped at 0.4, with a 12-round gain cooldown and decay of 0.002 per elapsed round. Mere proximity or ownership does not maintain it. Use one functional refuge source across all shelter aliases and structures; do not duplicate existing understanding or practice rewards. Actual new, interpretable material experiments may emit information-confirmed under the existing grounded-understanding rule, using its existing novelty, cap and cooldown checks. Implement resting-shelter@1 through the current development handoff. Public schema: object, additionalProperties:false; required fields mode, project, target, materials, x, y, angle; mode enum inspect/test/build/resume/repair/dismantle/cancel; project and target strings, materials array of {item:string,quantity:number>0}, x/y/angle finite numbers. Empty target/materials are permitted only when unused. References resolve exact persistent actor, item, source, project and structure IDs, never encoding markers or resource aliases. Learning takes 4 rounds, separately from implementation and use. Dependencies: existing inventory, gathering, probe material laws, rest, weather/exposure, collision and event systems; reuse their code without declaring shelter functionally equivalent to them. No hard tool, bark, assay apparatus or absolute hardness measurement is required.
State: retain component identities, source batches, actual mass and dimensions, paid tests, moisture, strength, joints, coverage, position, orientation, integrity, owner, escrow, completed stages and remaining work. Add versioned branch/reed/vine geometry and bending/tension laws wherever missing. Dimensions must conserve represented mass and volume; initialize previously unrepresented geometry consistently once, preserving lineage and damage, without supplying extra stock or treating tested fragments as intact poles. Inspect measures actual geometry in one round at 0.2 energy. Test performs two rounds at 0.5 energy each on explicitly allocated material, measuring bending or knot-slip resistance under bounded loads; preserve the altered sample, deformation and any conserved fragments. Generic material names and the previous small branch press trial do not establish roof capacity.
Smallest construction: a low open-ended A-frame shade shelter, footprint 1.8 by 1.2, ridge height 1.0, with one 1.8-long ridge, four rafters at least 1.2 long and ground-supported bracing. Allocate at least 6 branch units, 6 reed units and 2 vine units from real stacks; these quantities are minimums, not guaranteed suitability. Require enough usable pole lengths, mat area and lash length after actual tests. No cutting or fabricated hardware is assumed. Derive roof coverage from actual woven material area, gaps and slope; reject geometrically impossible assemblies before reserving inputs. Validate a clear footprint, ground support, reachable work locations and open exits against shared world geometry. Construction has 10 performed stages at 0.8 energy each: frame fitting, lashings, roof weaving and placement, then a final self-weight plus bounded lateral-load proof. Use measured capacities with a safety factor of 2 against modeled dead load and current wind load. Failed proof produces a damaged partial structure and conserved salvage, not a usable shelter. No person-bearing roof or severe-weather protection is implied.
Each successful stage transfers only its installed allocations from owner escrow into the partial structure. Missing energy, access or usable material pauses without charges; global pauses preserve exact progress. Action change, death or explicit cancellation stops active work and releases surviving uninstalled escrow exactly once, to the owner or ground at the project if the owner is dead. Installed material remains in place. Resume locks the same surviving project and executes only actual remaining work. No cloning, deletion, effort refund or automatic replacement. Repair explicitly allocates tested compatible replacement components, takes two rounds at 0.8 energy per replaced joint or roof panel, and retains removed salvage. Dismantling takes four rounds at 0.5 energy, releasing actual surviving components progressively; interruption preserves the remainder.
Physical effects: register roof polygons, pole colliders and interaction surfaces, not a solid rectangular room. Actors can pass through open ends; poles obstruct movement and the roof participates in overhead ray/contact tests. For occupants actually beneath intact roof polygons, compute coverage c in [0,1] from directional sun/rain/wind intersections. Reduce incident solar heat by 0.65*c and incident rain wetting by 0.4*c; reduce wind exposure only by the actual projected obstruction, capped at 0.2. Feed these changes into the real temperature/wetness/exposure update, with no direct temperature reset, hunger relief or healing. Wetting, decay, joint creep and wind overload reduce condition using the versioned material laws every round; structural failure removes corresponding roof coverage immediately. Exits must remain traversable. Rest continues to use its existing energy cap and mental factor: permit at most +0.4 nominal recovery only when the shelter actually reduces that actor's computed exposure penalty, bounded by the penalty removed. No bonus in already comfortable conditions, and trapped heat may worsen comfort. Existing physical comfort derives from actual hunger, health, fatigue and temperature.
Declare shelter-inspected, shelter-material-tested, shelter-progress, shelter-completed, shelter-stopped, shelter-damaged, shelter-repaired, shelter-dismantled and shelter-rest-experience events. Publish component allocations, measured capacities, effort, remaining work, geometry, coverage, exposure deltas and failure causes in replay records.
